content:
Looking for iPhone and iPad games that suit you? The App Store is not short of games without ads and in-app purchases.

Apple Arcade is a subscription option perfect for the whole family, but it's not the only option. If you're subscribed to Netflix, you're already paying for a host of exciting iPhone and iPad games.

Your Netflix subscription includes a massive catalogue of iPhone and iPad games

Every Netflix subscription tier now includes a massive library of mobile and smart TV games.

Among them is the most affordable "Standard with ads" Netflix subscription plan, at US$8.99 per month.

Regardless of which Netflix tier you've chosen, access to mobile and smart TV games is ad-free, with no in-app purchases and no extra fees.

For smart TV gaming, Netflix offers a dedicated iPhone and iPad app called Netflix Game Controller.

This app can turn your phone or tablet into a game controller, used to operate supported games on the Netflix smart TV app. If you want to upgrade your mobile gaming experience, a proper dedicated iPhone game controller is the way to go.

Netflix also has another iPhone and iPad app called Netflix Playground, offering mini-games designed for young children. There's also Netflix Puzzled: Logic Games (no subscription required) and Netflix Stories.

In addition to the games mentioned above, Netflix also supports a catalogue of over 80 iPhone and iPad games. You can download any one of them from the App Store, then log in with your Netflix email and password to play.
